origin.app: Perfusion Application Hub (Google AI Studio), 2025-26 cycle

import_policy.claim_state: known only for name/city/degree/url; every numeric or date field enters as 'unknown' until re-sourced
import_policy.rationale: This corpus has one URL per school and no per-fact citation, quote, or check date. Nothing in it satisfies the CLAUDE.md rule that every fact retain an official source URL and a source_checked_at. It is a research lead list, not verified data. Import must never set verification=verified.

known_issues: Deadlines are unanchored strings ("Mar 1", "Rolling", "CLOSED", "July 1 2025") mixing three formats and mostly lacking a year.
GPA 3.0 appears in 17 of 23 records, strongly suggesting a placeholder rather than a sourced minimum.
Tuition mixes units: University of Iowa 2100 against University of Utah 120000 are not the same measure.
Baylor College of Medicine duplicates Texas Heart Institute (same URL, "Certificate (via THI)").
Vanderbilt is marked CLOSED for 2025-2027 and Baylor carries a July 1 2025 deadline; both are past-cycle.
Personal state in the old app was keyed by school NAME in localStorage, not by a stable id.
Credential values use four spellings for two things: Cert, Certificate, "Certificate (via THI)", alongside MS/MHS/MPS. Must normalise to the credential enum.
